core_obligations: Stacks stackification-inertia lemma: suffices to identify the presheaf-level inertia.
Objects of the inertia fibred category: (x, g) with x = s(g) = t(g), i.e. g: T -> G (stabilizer fibre).
Morphisms: r with s(r) = x, t(r) = y and c(r,g) = c(h,r), i.e. h = c(r, c(g, i(r))) (displayed, from the Categories inertia lemma).
These correspond exactly to R'-points (r, g) with s'(r,g) = g, t'(r,g) = c(r,c(g,i(r))); composition matches (3).
